methods.name: Object-Based Image Analysis (OBIA)
methods.summary: A multi-resolution segmentation and rule-based classification approach using spectral, geometric, and contextual parameters to identify landslides, implemented in e-Cognition Developer 9.
methods.verbatim: Using e-Coginition Developer 9, a trial-and-error approach was used to choose input parameters for identifying landslides in this study.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom method code lacks a repository or persistent link.
